site.title: X-Piratez
site.footer: X-Piratez — a fan modification of UFO: Enemy Unknown / OpenXcom. Player support site.
home.title: X-Piratez
home.lead: The mod rewrites the graphics of OpenXcom and touches no mechanics: same numbers, same turn order, a different resolution. Here you will find the launcher, a section per mod, the wiki and the forum.
home.version.unknown: Version information is unavailable right now.
home.report.title: Found a bug?
home.report.text: Tell us what happened. No account needed: you will get a private link to your ticket.
field.title: Summary
field.name: Display name
new.title: Report a problem
new.guest.hint: No account needed. After sending you get a private link — keep it, replies show up there.
new.category.hint: Artists handle graphics, programmers handle game bugs: the right area gets a faster answer.
new.files.hint: Up to {0} files, up to {1} MB each: images, .log, .txt, .sav saves, .zip archives.
new.consent: I allow attaching logs and saves. They may contain your Windows user name and folder paths; only the developers will see them.
new.done.files_failed: Your ticket has been sent, but some files were refused — check their type and size and add them below.
view.keep_link: Keep the address of this page: it is your private access to the ticket. Do not share it.
view.images_only: Without consent to logs and saves only images can be added.
view.closed: The ticket is closed. If the problem is back, open a new one.
register.title: Register
register.sent: If the address is free, a confirmation link has been sent to it.
register.guest_ok: You do not need an account to report a bug.
confirm.title: E-mail confirmation
confirm.ok: Your e-mail is confirmed. You can sign in now.
confirm.bad: The link is invalid or has expired.
login.title: Sign in
login2fa.title: Second sign-in step
forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.sent: If this address is registered and confirmed, a reset link has been sent to it.
reset.title: New password
reset.done: Password changed; all previous sessions are closed.
denied.title: No access
denied.text: Your account has no access to this page.
denied.need2fa: Team pages open only after a sign-in with two-factor authentication. Turn it on and sign in again.
security.title: Security
security.step1: Install an authenticator app (Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password, etc.).
security.step3: Enter the six-digit code from the app.
security.open_app: Open in an app on this device
security.disable.code: Code from the app to turn it off
security.recovery.title: Recovery codes
security.recovery.text: Keep them somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
security.relogin: Two-factor is on. Sign in again, with a code from the app.
admin.search: Number or words from the title
admin.no_categories: You have no areas assigned. Ask a SuperAdmin.
admin.author: Author
admin.internal_note: Internal note — the author will not see it
super.telegram.hint: A new ticket notice goes to its area's route, or to the default route if there is none.
super.telegram.no_token: The bot token is not set (Telegram__BotToken): notices pile up in the queue and are not sent.
mail.confirm.subject: X-Piratez: confirm your e-mail
mail.reset.subject: X-Piratez: password reset
assignee_not_allowed: This person does not work on this area.
cannot_demote_self: You cannot remove the SuperAdmin role from yourself.
last_superadmin: This is the last SuperAdmin; the role cannot be removed.
chat_invalid: chat id is a number (-100… for groups) or @channelname.
consent_required: Logs, saves and archives need your consent to attach them.
email_not_confirmed: Your e-mail is not confirmed yet — check your mail.
file_content_mismatch: The file's content does not match its type.
file_type_not_allowed: This file type is not accepted.
idempotency_key_reused: This form was already sent with other content. Reload the page.
internal_staff_only: Only the team writes internal notes.
login_locked: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
multipart_required: Send the file as a form.
name_invalid: The name must be 1 to 64 characters.
reset_invalid: The reset link is invalid or has expired.
status_move_invalid: This status change is not allowed.
ticket_files_too_large: The ticket's files are too large in total.
use_duplicate: Mark duplicates with the duplicate action.
identity.PasswordRequiresLower: The password needs a lowercase letter.
identity.PasswordRequiresUpper: The password needs an uppercase letter.
identity.PasswordRequiresUniqueChars: The password has too few distinct characters.
identity.DefaultError: That did not work. Try again.
language_invalid: The language is a code like ru, en or pt-BR.
file_not_text: The file must be text (UTF-8), but it holds binary data.
file_not_save: This is not an OpenXcom save: there is no name/version header.
zip_content_not_allowed: The archive holds files that may not be attached, or another archive.
home.headline: HD graphics for X-Piratez
home.mods.text: A section per mod: what it is, how it differs, where to get it.
home.wiki.text: Items, armour and research, read out of the mod's own rulesets.

mods.title: Mods
mods.lead: Every mod gets its own section: description, links, wiki and a board of its own.
mods.author: Author
wiki.title: Wiki
wiki.lead: A reference for the mods. Pages marked «from rulesets» are built from the mod's own files, so their numbers are the numbers in the game.
wiki.empty.mod: This mod has no articles yet.
wiki.derived: Built from the rulesets of version {0} ({1}). An edit here is overwritten by the next import.
wiki.derived.warn: This is a generated page. The next import from the rulesets overwrites whatever you write here.
wiki.other.language: The article does not exist in your language yet - showing the one that does.
wiki.history.none: No edits: the page is in its first version.
wiki.history.hint: A row holds what the page said BEFORE that edit.
wiki.slug.hint: Latin letters, digits and dashes. Leave empty to build it from the title.
wiki.body.hint: Markdown. HTML tags do not work: they show up as text.
wiki.err.title: The title is empty.
wiki.err.slug: An address takes latin letters, digits and dashes only.
wiki.err.taken: An article with that address already exists.
forum.title: Forum
forum.lead: Questions, findings, builds and arguments. Reading needs no account, writing does.
forum.staff.only.hint: Topics here are started by the project team.
forum.locked.hint: The topic is locked: nothing more can be posted in it.
forum.markdown: Markdown. HTML tags do not work: they show up as text.
forum.post.removed: The post was taken down by a moderator.
forum.err.long: The post is longer than allowed.
forum.err.title: The title is empty.
forum.err.title.long: The title is longer than allowed.
